title: Yemeni–Ottoman conflicts
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Yemeni–Ottoman conflicts", at revision 1382961738, opens: "The Yemeni–Ottoman wars were a series of conflicts between the Ottoman Empire and Zaidi tribes in Upper Yemen, which began in 1538 and ended with the signing of the Treaty of Daan on 9 October 1911." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q60771401, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "series of conflicts between the Ottoman Empire and Zaidi tribes in Upper Yemen". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
